text:
taylor: FYI planning a scoped entitlement handback for reporting services Thurs. Found several ownerless org-admins during the periodic review. Will ensure KMS decrypt for report-generator.

nina: +1. Can we do a pre-flight that simulates decrypt with the target service accounts?

taylor: Yes. Plan: 1) create narrow key binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/reports/cryptoKeys/report-decrypt and grant cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to serviceAccount:report-generator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com; 2) run impersonated decrypt smoke; 3) drop org-admin; 4) monitor for 30m.

rolf: Need CI gate. I'll add a quick check that uses workload-identity to impersonate and decrypt a test blob. If CI fails, block the PR.

access-scan-bot: Scan summary: ownerless admin grants detected: 5. report-generator flagged as indirect KMS access via org-admin. See /security/scans/17488.

nina: Make sure audit logs include protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail and the key request logs are routed to the security sink.

taylor: Will route decrypt events to the security sink and add Splunk forwarding for rapid paging. Also will use exact serviceAccount principal in IAM binding, no wildcards.

rolf: Rollback script ready: scripts/reapply-org-admins.sh. Oncall will also have a manual revert if automation fails.

oncall-bot: Scheduled window: 2024-07-18T03:00Z-2024-07-18T05:00Z. Pager enabled for decrypt error rate >0.5% over baseline.

taylor: OK opening PR with canary gating and runbook steps. Tagging @nina @rolf for review; will post CI PR and key creation commands in comments.

nina: :thumbsup:
